words.enDefinition: an arrangement with a provider for mobile calls, texts, or data

examples.en: I compared my mobile phone plan with the options listed at the student fair.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「手机通信套餐」与学生展会上列出的选项作了比较。

examples.en: The mobile phone plan included calls but gave me less data than I expected.
examples.zh: 「手机通信套餐」包含通话，给我的流量比预期少。

words.enDefinition: a voucher that adds prepaid credit to a mobile account

examples.en: I bought a top-up voucher at the shop opposite the residence hall entrance.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍楼入口对面的商店买了一张「手机充值券」。

examples.en: The cashier showed me where the value was printed on the top-up voucher.
examples.zh: 收银员给我指出了「手机充值券」面值印在哪里。

words.enDefinition: money stored on a prepaid mobile account for future use

examples.en: I still had enough mobile credit to make a call after my class ended.
examples.zh: 下课后，我的「预付手机账户余额」还够打一次电话。

examples.en: The app showed my remaining mobile credit next to the history of recent top-ups.
examples.zh: 应用在近期充值记录旁显示了我剩余的「预付手机账户余额」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that adds prepaid credit automatically at a specified time or balance level

examples.en: I turned off auto top-up before leaving the country for my summer break.
examples.zh: 暑假出国前，我关闭了「自动充值」。

examples.en: The provider sent a reminder before the next auto top-up on my mobile account.
examples.zh: 下次为手机账户「自动充值」之前，运营商发来了一条提醒。

words.enDefinition: a service plan that continues one month at a time without a longer fixed term

examples.en: I chose a monthly rolling plan because my placement ended halfway through the year.
examples.zh: 我实习年中就结束了，所以选了「逐月续期套餐」。

examples.en: The shop explained which features came with the monthly rolling plan for my phone.
examples.zh: 商店解释了我的手机「逐月续期套餐」包含哪些功能。

collocations: switch to a monthly rolling plan

words.enDefinition: a mobile service plan supplied without a new handset

examples.en: I kept my old phone and chose a SIM-only plan for the exchange semester.
examples.zh: 交换学期我继续用旧手机，选了「不含手机的通信套餐」。

examples.en: The SIM-only plan was listed separately from deals that included a new device.
examples.zh: 「不含手机的通信套餐」与附带新设备的优惠分开列出。

collocations: sign up for a SIM-only plan

words.enDefinition: a SIM for mobile internet access without ordinary voice service

examples.en: I used a data-only SIM in my tablet on the way to campus.
examples.zh: 去校园的路上，我在平板里用了一张「仅供上网的手机卡」。

examples.en: The data-only SIM worked with my device but didn't give me a voice line.
examples.zh: 「仅供上网的手机卡」适用于我的设备，但不提供普通语音通话线路。

words.enDefinition: a removable card that connects a mobile device to a subscriber's service

examples.en: My older phone still used a physical SIM even after I changed my plan.
examples.zh: 我更改套餐后，老手机仍使用「实体手机卡」。

examples.en: The assistant asked whether I needed a physical SIM for my spare phone.
examples.zh: 店员问备用手机需不需要「实体手机卡」。

words.enDefinition: the opening in a device where a removable SIM card fits

examples.en: The guide pointed out the SIM card slot on the side of the old handset.
examples.zh: 指南指出了旧手机侧面的「手机卡插槽」。

examples.en: I checked whether the SIM card slot was on the same side on both models.
examples.zh: 我确认了两个型号的「手机卡插槽」是否在同一侧。

collocations: cover for the SIM card slot

words.enDefinition: a very small physical SIM card used in certain mobile devices

examples.en: The shop checked that my phone took a nano-SIM before handing over the packet.
examples.zh: 店家先确认我的手机使用「最小规格的手机卡」，才把卡包交给我。

examples.en: I found the spare nano-SIM in the drawer with my old student cards.
examples.zh: 我在装旧学生证的抽屉里找到了备用的「最小规格的手机卡」。

words.enDefinition: downloaded information that connects an eSIM to a specific mobile service

examples.en: The support page described each eSIM profile by the name of its mobile network.
examples.zh: 帮助页用运营商网络的名称来区分每个「电子SIM服务配置」。

examples.en: My phone displayed the eSIM profile for the mobile plan I used abroad last summer.
examples.zh: 手机显示了我去年暑假在国外用的套餐的「电子SIM服务配置」。

words.enDefinition: a device feature supporting two SIM-based mobile lines on the same phone

examples.en: The dual SIM feature let me keep a separate number for my part-time job.
examples.zh: 有了「双卡功能」，我能为兼职保留一个单独的号码。

examples.en: I chose a handset with dual SIM because I studied in two different countries.
examples.zh: 我在两个不同国家读书，所以选了具有「双卡功能」的手机。

words.enDefinition: the process of enabling a SIM to work with its assigned mobile service

examples.en: The provider sent an email confirming SIM activation while I was travelling to university.
examples.zh: 我在去学校的路上，运营商发来邮件确认「手机卡开通」。

examples.en: I checked the SIM activation status on the account page before calling support.
examples.zh: 联系支持人员前，我先在账户页查看了「手机卡开通」状态。

words.enDefinition: the main mobile line a person uses on a device with multiple lines

examples.en: I kept my work number as the primary line while studying near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近读书期间，我把工作号码设为「主要手机线路」。

examples.en: The phone showed a little icon beside the primary line in the settings menu.
examples.zh: 手机设置菜单里，「主要手机线路」旁显示了一个小图标。

words.enDefinition: an additional mobile line used alongside a main line on a device

examples.en: The secondary line was useful when I needed a separate number for my placement.
examples.zh: 实习需要一个独立号码时，「第二手机线路」就派上了用场。

examples.en: I checked which plan I had assigned to the secondary line before going abroad.
examples.zh: 出国前，我确认了「第二手机线路」使用哪一个套餐。

words.enDefinition: the mobile line normally used for outgoing voice calls when none is selected

examples.en: After changing phones, I checked which number was set as the default voice line.
examples.zh: 换手机后，我查看了哪个号码设为「默认通话号码」。

examples.en: The settings listed my default voice line separately from the line used for mobile data.
examples.zh: 设置把「默认通话号码」和用于手机流量的线路分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a company that provides mobile network service to customers

examples.en: My mobile carrier sent a notice about coverage near the university's new building.
examples.zh: 我的「移动通信运营商」发了一条关于学校新楼附近网络覆盖的通知。

examples.en: I asked which mobile carrier offered service on the train route to my hometown.
examples.zh: 我问去老家的铁路沿线哪家「移动通信运营商」提供服务。

words.enDefinition: a mobile service provider that uses another company's network infrastructure

examples.en: I had not heard of the mobile virtual network operator listed in the campus brochure.
examples.zh: 我以前没听说过校园宣传册中列出的那家「虚拟移动通信运营商」。

examples.en: The mobile virtual network operator used a larger provider's network in our area.
examples.zh: 这家「虚拟移动通信运营商」在我们这一带使用较大的运营商的网络。

collocations: choose a mobile virtual network operator
services from a mobile virtual network operator

words.enDefinition: device settings that tell a phone how to work with a mobile network

examples.en: The phone asked whether I wanted to update my carrier settings after changing plans.
examples.zh: 更换套餐后，手机询问我要不要更新「运营商配置」。

examples.en: The help desk checked the carrier settings before testing the new mobile line.
examples.zh: 技术服务台先核对了「运营商配置」，再测试新的手机线路。

words.enDefinition: an online tool for checking expected network availability at a place

examples.en: I used a coverage checker to compare reception around my new hall of residence.
examples.zh: 我用「网络覆盖查询工具」比较了新宿舍附近的信号。

examples.en: The coverage checker showed different results depending on which street I entered that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，我输入的街道不同时，「网络覆盖查询工具」显示的结果也不一样。

collocations: check a postcode with a coverage checker

words.enDefinition: a map showing where a provider expects its service to be available

examples.en: The network coverage map showed an area of weaker reception behind the campus library.
examples.zh: 「网络覆盖地图」显示校园图书馆后面有一块信号较弱的区域。

examples.en: I compared the network coverage map with what I noticed during my train commute.
examples.zh: 我对照了「网络覆盖地图」和自己坐火车通勤时的实际感受。

words.enDefinition: bars on a device display indicating the relative strength of its mobile signal

examples.en: The reception bars dropped to one when I moved to the basement study room.
examples.zh: 我走到地下室的自习室时，「手机信号格」降到了一格。

examples.en: My phone showed more reception bars once the bus came out of the long tunnel.
examples.zh: 公交车一出长隧道，我的「手机信号格」就多了。

words.enDefinition: the wireless signal a mobile device receives from a cellular network

examples.en: The concrete walls made the cellular signal weaker in the back of the building.
examples.zh: 混凝土墙让楼后部的「蜂窝网络信号」更弱。

examples.en: My phone picked up a stronger cellular signal once I reached the open courtyard.
examples.zh: 走到开阔的庭院后，我的手机接收到更强的「蜂窝网络信号」。

words.enDefinition: the area or quality of a mobile network signal inside buildings

examples.en: I checked the indoor coverage at my new address before choosing a provider.
examples.zh: 选择运营商前，我查了新住址的「室内网络覆盖」。

examples.en: The provider warned that indoor coverage might vary between different floors of the building.
examples.zh: 运营商提醒，楼里不同楼层的「室内网络覆盖」可能不同。

words.enDefinition: a tower supporting equipment that sends and receives mobile network signals

examples.en: We could see the cell tower from the bus stop next to campus.
examples.zh: 从学校旁的公交站，我们能看见「移动通信基站塔」。

examples.en: The company listed work on a nearby cell tower in its public maintenance notice.
examples.zh: 公司在公开维护通知里列出了附近一座「移动通信基站塔」的施工。

words.enDefinition: slowdowns or delays when more traffic uses a network than it can handle well

examples.en: I noticed network congestion during the first week when everyone was online after dinner.
examples.zh: 第一周大家晚饭后都上网，我注意到了「网络拥塞」。

examples.en: The provider listed network congestion as a possible reason for slower speeds during the festival.
examples.zh: 运营商把「网络拥塞」列为节庆期间网速变慢的一种可能原因。

words.enDefinition: a webpage reporting whether a provider's services are operating normally

examples.en: I opened the service status page when our mobile calls suddenly started dropping.
examples.zh: 手机通话突然开始断线时，我打开了「服务运行状态页」。

examples.en: The service status page showed an issue with data in our area that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午，「服务运行状态页」显示我们这一带的流量服务出了问题。

words.enDefinition: a phone status indicating ordinary service is unavailable but emergency calling may be possible

examples.en: My phone showed emergency calls only when I checked it inside the station tunnel.
examples.zh: 我在车站隧道里查看手机时，显示「仅限紧急呼叫」。

examples.en: A message marked emergency calls only appeared after the phone stopped finding its usual network.
examples.zh: 手机找不到常用网络以后，出现了「仅限紧急呼叫」的提示。

words.enDefinition: a phone status showing it is trying to find an available cellular network

examples.en: My phone showed searching for network for several seconds after leaving the parking garage.
examples.zh: 我离开停车库后，手机有几秒显示「正在搜索网络」。

examples.en: I saw searching for network on the screen when our train reached the station.
examples.zh: 火车抵达车站时，我在屏幕上看到了「正在搜索网络」。

words.enDefinition: high-speed internet access provided through a cellular network

examples.en: The residence used mobile broadband while the building's wired connection was being repaired.
examples.zh: 楼里的有线网络维修期间，宿舍使用了「移动宽带」。

examples.en: My flatmate borrowed a device with mobile broadband during a weekend trip away.
examples.zh: 室友周末外出时借了一台带「移动宽带」的设备。

words.enDefinition: the fourth generation of mobile network technology

examples.en: Our phones switched to 4G when the train moved farther from the city centre.
examples.zh: 火车离市中心更远后，我们的手机切换到了「第四代移动网络」。

examples.en: The coverage map showed 4G service along much of my usual bus route to campus.
examples.zh: 覆盖地图显示，我平时坐公交上学的大部分路段有「第四代移动网络」服务。

words.enDefinition: the fifth generation of mobile network technology

examples.en: I saw 5G on the screen while waiting for my bus outside the library.
examples.zh: 在图书馆外等公交时，我看见屏幕上显示「第五代移动网络」。

examples.en: The phone supported 5G, but the signal varied between my dorm and the station.
examples.zh: 那部手机支持「第五代移动网络」，不过宿舍和车站之间的信号有变化。

words.zhGloss: 第四代移动通信技术之一
words.enDefinition: a mobile network technology widely used for 4G service
acceptedZhAnswers: 第四代移动通信技术之一

examples.en: My phone displayed LTE when I checked whether the data connection was active.
examples.zh: 我确认数据连接是否启用时，手机显示了「LTE」。

examples.en: The carrier's map marked LTE coverage along the main road into the university town.
examples.zh: 运营商的地图标出了通往大学城的主路沿线的「LTE」覆盖范围。

words.enDefinition: the mobile technology a device is set to use when available

examples.en: I checked my preferred network type after noticing the phone stayed on an older network.
examples.zh: 我发现手机一直连着较旧的网络，就查了「首选网络类型」。

examples.en: The handset showed the preferred network type below the names of both mobile lines.
examples.zh: 手机在两条线路的名称下方显示了「首选网络类型」。

words.enDefinition: a setting letting a device choose an available compatible cellular network by itself

examples.en: The phone used automatic network selection when my bus crossed into the next country.
examples.zh: 公交车驶入邻国时，手机用了「自动选择移动网络」功能。

examples.en: I checked whether automatic network selection was enabled on the second line after the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行后，我查看第二条线路是否开启了「自动选择移动网络」。

words.enDefinition: a feature using Wi-Fi to carry ordinary phone calls on a supporting plan

examples.en: I used Wi-Fi calling in the residence because the mobile signal was hard to get.
examples.zh: 宿舍里手机信号不容易收到，我用了「无线网络通话」。

examples.en: The provider explained how Wi-Fi calling appeared on my device when I made a call.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了打电话时，手机上怎样显示「无线网络通话」。

words.enDefinition: phone calling that carries voice through the LTE mobile network

examples.en: The provider said voice over LTE was available on the handset I had brought.
examples.zh: 运营商说，我带来的手机可以用「LTE网络语音通话」。

examples.en: I checked the settings for voice over LTE after changing the device's mobile plan.
examples.zh: 我更换设备的通信套餐后，查看了「LTE网络语音通话」的设置。

words.enDefinition: technology for transmitting voice calls over an internet protocol network

examples.en: Our student office used voice over internet protocol for calls made from its desk phones.
examples.zh: 学生办公室的座机用的是「互联网协议语音通话」技术。

examples.en: The brochure mentioned voice over internet protocol separately from the mobile voice plan I had.
examples.zh: 宣传册把「互联网协议语音通话」和我现有的手机通话套餐分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: how clearly and reliably a voice call can be heard

examples.en: The call quality was noticeably better after I walked out of the crowded station.
examples.zh: 我走出拥挤的车站后，「通话质量」明显好转。

examples.en: My flatmate asked me about call quality before choosing the same mobile provider.
examples.zh: 室友选择同一家手机运营商之前，问我「通话质量」怎么样。

words.enDefinition: using mobile service on another provider's network while abroad

examples.en: I checked the international roaming section before going on my university exchange trip.
examples.zh: 参加学校的出国交流之前，我查看了「国际漫游」一栏。

examples.en: The support agent explained where international roaming was included in my plan.
examples.zh: 客服解释了我的套餐在哪些地方包含「国际漫游」。

words.enDefinition: a fee for using a mobile device through another provider's network away from home

examples.en: The bill showed a roaming charge beside the calls I made during the trip.
examples.zh: 账单在我旅行中打的电话旁边列了一笔「漫游费用」。

examples.en: I asked why a roaming charge appeared when I thought the destination was included.
examples.zh: 我以为目的地包含在套餐里，就问为什么会出现「漫游费用」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary package giving specified mobile service away from the user's usual network

examples.en: I bought a roaming pass before the weekend conference in the neighbouring country.
examples.zh: 我在去邻国参加周末会议前买了「漫游短期套餐」。

examples.en: The account showed when the roaming pass would stop working during my trip.
examples.zh: 账户显示了旅行期间「漫游短期套餐」何时会失效。

words.enDefinition: a geographical group of places treated alike under a provider's roaming arrangements

examples.en: The provider showed a different roaming zone for the two countries on my itinerary.
examples.zh: 运营商显示，我行程里的两个国家分属不同的「漫游计费区」。

examples.en: I checked which roaming zone included the place we were visiting for the conference.
examples.zh: 我查了开会要去的地方属于哪个「漫游计费区」。

words.enDefinition: an add-on supplying specified allowance or rates for calls to other countries

examples.en: I added an international calling bundle because I rang my family every weekend.
examples.zh: 因为每周末都给家里打电话，我加订了「国际通话组合包」。

examples.en: The international calling bundle did not include calls made while I was abroad.
examples.zh: 我的「国际通话组合包」不包含我在国外时打的电话。

words.enDefinition: a plan allowance of time for calling telephone numbers in other countries

examples.en: I checked my remaining international minutes before calling my parents from the residence.
examples.zh: 从宿舍给父母打电话前，我查看了剩余的「国际通话分钟数」。

examples.en: The account listed international minutes separately from the time available for domestic calls.
examples.zh: 账户把「国际通话分钟数」和国内通话可用时长分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the amount of calling time covered by the price of a phone plan

examples.en: I read the terms for included minutes before calling the admissions office from home.
examples.zh: 在家打电话给招生处之前，我看了「套餐内通话分钟数」的条款。

examples.en: The app showed how many included minutes I had left after calling the student services office.
examples.zh: 给学生服务办公室打完电话后，应用显示我还剩多少「套餐内通话分钟数」。

words.enDefinition: a service that sends incoming calls from one number to another

examples.en: I checked whether call forwarding was still active after changing my spare phone.
examples.zh: 换掉备用手机后，我确认了「呼叫转接功能」是否仍启用。

examples.en: The provider listed call forwarding separately from the phone's built-in voicemail feature.
examples.zh: 运营商把「呼叫转接功能」和手机内置的语音信箱功能分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a service showing voicemail messages in a list so they can be selected individually

examples.en: I opened visual voicemail to play the message that arrived just after class.
examples.zh: 我打开「可视化语音信箱」，播放了下课后刚收到的那条留言。

examples.en: The provider added visual voicemail to the options shown for my second line.
examples.zh: 运营商在第二条线路的可用选项里加了「可视化语音信箱」。

words.enDefinition: an alert telling someone a new voicemail is available

examples.en: I got a voicemail notification while the train was passing through the university town.
examples.zh: 火车经过大学城时，我收到了一条「语音留言通知」。

examples.en: The voicemail notification stayed on my screen until I listened to the message.
examples.zh: 我收听留言后，「语音留言通知」才从屏幕上消失。

words.enDefinition: a service displaying identifying information about an incoming telephone call

examples.en: I recognised the campus office on caller ID when the phone rang that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午手机响时，我从「来电号码显示」认出是校园办公室。

examples.en: The caller ID showed an unfamiliar number while I was waiting for my appointment.
examples.zh: 我等预约时，「来电号码显示」出了一个陌生号码。

words.enDefinition: a caller whose number or name cannot be identified by the receiving phone

examples.en: My phone marked the call as unknown caller while I was on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公交上时，手机把来电标为「未知来电」。

examples.en: I let the unknown caller leave a message about the change to my appointment.
examples.zh: 我没接那通「未知来电」，对方留了言，说预约时间有变化。

words.enDefinition: a feature notifying someone of a second incoming call while already on a call

examples.en: I heard the call waiting tone while speaking to the adviser about my timetable.
examples.zh: 我正和顾问谈课表，听到了「呼叫等待」提示音。

examples.en: The instructions showed whether my phone could use call waiting with both lines active.
examples.zh: 说明解释了两条线路都启用时，我的手机能不能用「呼叫等待」。

words.enDefinition: a feature or practice for assessing an incoming call before answering it

examples.en: My phone's call screening feature asked unexpected callers to say their names aloud.
examples.zh: 手机的「来电筛选」功能会请不在预期内的来电者报上姓名。

examples.en: I read the call screening settings because I was waiting for an unfamiliar campus number.
examples.zh: 我在等校园的一个陌生号码打来，就看了「来电筛选」设置。

words.enDefinition: a notice reporting whether a text message was delivered

examples.en: I checked the text message delivery report after sending the new meeting address to my friend.
examples.zh: 我把新碰头地址发给朋友后，查看了「短信送达报告」。

examples.en: The text message delivery report arrived a minute after I stepped out of the lift.
examples.zh: 我走出电梯一分钟后，收到了「短信送达报告」。

collocations: request a text message delivery report
receive a text message delivery report
check the text message delivery report

words.enDefinition: a service for sending and receiving short text messages over mobile networks

examples.en: The university sent an SMS to confirm my arrival time for the orientation session.
examples.zh: 学校发了条「普通手机短信」，确认我到迎新活动的时间。

examples.en: I received the update by SMS because my mobile data wasn't working that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午移动流量不能用，我通过「普通手机短信」收到了更新。

words.enDefinition: a mobile messaging service that can include pictures, audio, or video

examples.en: The photo arrived as an MMS rather than through the app we usually used.
examples.zh: 照片是以「多媒体短信」收到的，不是通过我们常用的应用。

examples.en: My older plan listed a separate charge for each MMS I sent abroad.
examples.zh: 我的旧套餐对我在国外发出的每条「多媒体短信」单独收费。

words.enDefinition: a mobile messaging standard supporting richer chat features than ordinary texts

examples.en: My phone showed RCS under messaging settings when I checked the new line.
examples.zh: 我查看新线路时，手机的消息设置下显示了「富通信消息服务」。

examples.en: The carrier explained which devices could use RCS with its service that term.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了该学期哪些设备可以在其网络上使用「富通信消息服务」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a message failed to reach its intended recipient

examples.en: My phone showed message not delivered after I sent the address from the subway.
examples.zh: 我在地铁里发送地址后，手机提示「消息未送达」。

examples.en: The app displayed message not delivered before asking whether I wanted to try again.
examples.zh: 应用显示「消息未送达」，接着问我要不要重试。

collocations: message not delivered to the recipient

words.enDefinition: a text message sent to a group of people, or a conversation made up of such messages

examples.en: My classmates sent a group text when our usual meeting room was suddenly closed.
examples.zh: 我们平时碰头的房间突然关闭，同学们发了条「群发短信」。

examples.en: I found the bus departure time in the group text from my study friends.
examples.zh: 我在学习伙伴的「群组短信」中找到了公交车发车时间。

words.enDefinition: the amount of internet data a phone uses over its cellular service

examples.en: I checked mobile data usage after watching several lectures on the bus that week.
examples.zh: 那周坐公交看了几节课后，我查看了「手机流量用量」。

examples.en: The phone listed mobile data usage by application for the current billing cycle.
examples.zh: 手机按应用列出了本计费周期的「手机流量用量」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of data provided within a mobile plan for a stated period

examples.en: My data allowance was smaller while I was travelling under the temporary plan.
examples.zh: 我旅行期间用临时套餐，「套餐内流量」比较少。

examples.en: I compared the data allowance before choosing a new plan for the next semester.
examples.zh: 选下学期的新套餐前，我比较了「套餐内流量」。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying data usage is near or at a set limit

examples.en: The data limit alert appeared while I was viewing a lecture away from campus.
examples.zh: 我在校外看讲课视频时，弹出了「流量额度提醒」。

examples.en: I received a data limit alert before using the rest of the monthly allowance.
examples.zh: 我用完本月剩余流量前收到了「流量额度提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a fee for calls, texts, or data beyond what a plan includes

examples.en: The bill included an out-of-bundle charge for my call to an overseas number.
examples.zh: 账单上有我拨打海外号码产生的「套餐外费用」。

examples.en: I asked how the out-of-bundle charge appeared in the monthly statement for my plan.
examples.zh: 我问我的套餐每月对账单上怎样显示「套餐外费用」。

words.enDefinition: an extra amount of mobile data bought after or alongside the regular allowance

examples.en: I bought a data top-up to watch my online lecture on a long train ride.
examples.zh: 坐长途火车看在线课程前，我买了一个「流量加购包」。

examples.en: The data top-up showed separately from my usual allowance in the carrier's app.
examples.zh: 运营商应用把「流量加购包」与我平时的流量额度分开显示。

words.enDefinition: carrying unused mobile data from one allowance period into a later one

examples.en: The data rollover gave me extra allowance when I travelled the following month.
examples.zh: 下个月出行时，「剩余流量结转」给我增加了可用流量。

examples.en: I asked how data rollover worked before changing to the cheaper plan for summer.
examples.zh: 换成暑假更便宜的套餐前，我问了「剩余流量结转」怎么计算。

words.enDefinition: a mode that reduces the amount of data used by a device or application

examples.en: I switched on data saver before opening the news app on the train.
examples.zh: 坐火车时，我先开启了「节省流量功能」，再打开新闻应用。

examples.en: The app explained why images loaded differently when data saver was enabled that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，应用解释开启「节省流量功能」时图片加载方式为什么不同。

words.enDefinition: data used by apps that are not currently open on the screen

examples.en: My phone listed background data separately from the data used while I watched lectures.
examples.zh: 手机把「后台网络流量」与我观看课程时使用的流量分开列出。

examples.en: I checked which app had used the most background data during the night.
examples.zh: 我查看了哪个应用夜里使用了最多的「后台网络流量」。

words.enDefinition: the recurring period over which a device or plan counts data use

examples.en: I updated the data usage cycle to match the date on my account statement.
examples.zh: 我更新了「流量用量统计周期」，让它和账户对账单的日期一致。

examples.en: The settings showed the start of the next data usage cycle on Monday.
examples.zh: 设置显示，下一个「流量用量统计周期」从周一开始。

words.enDefinition: a summary separating mobile use into categories such as calls, messages, or data

examples.en: The usage breakdown showed that the extra charge came from a call I made while abroad.
examples.zh: 「通信使用量明细」显示，那笔额外费用来自我在境外拨打的一通电话。

examples.en: I checked the usage breakdown after comparing my plan with the students' offer.
examples.zh: 把自己的套餐与学生优惠比较后，我查了「通信使用量明细」。

words.zhGloss: 按流量计量的网络连接
words.enDefinition: an internet connection whose use is tracked and may count toward charges or limits
acceptedZhAnswers: 按流量计量的网络连接

examples.en: I used a metered connection while the usual campus network was unavailable that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚常用的校园网无法使用，我用了「按流量计量的网络连接」。

examples.en: The laptop asked whether the new Wi-Fi should be treated as a metered connection.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑询问，新的无线网要不要视为「按流量计量的网络连接」。

words.enDefinition: rules that limit unusually heavy use of a service even on some inclusive plans

examples.en: I read the fair use policy to see what it said about reduced speeds.
examples.zh: 我看了「通信合理使用政策」，想知道里面怎么说降速。

examples.en: The provider explained which parts of the fair use policy applied when I travelled.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了我旅行时适用「通信合理使用政策」中的哪些条款。

words.enDefinition: a lower rate for transferring mobile data than the usual service rate

examples.en: The note mentioned reduced data speed after the included monthly allowance had been used.
examples.zh: 说明写着套餐内月流量用完后，会对「移动网络降速」。

examples.en: I noticed the reduced data speed while loading slides from home that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午在家加载幻灯片时，我注意到了「移动网络降速」。

collocations: reduced data speed for the remainder of the month

words.enDefinition: intentional slowing of network traffic by a provider under certain conditions

examples.en: The help article mentioned network throttling when explaining a limit in my mobile plan.
examples.zh: 帮助文章在解释我套餐的一项限制时，提到了「运营商主动限速」。

examples.en: I asked whether the slower connection was due to network throttling or local congestion.
examples.zh: 我问网络变慢是因为「运营商主动限速」还是本地网络拥塞。

words.enDefinition: using one device's mobile connection to provide internet access to another device

examples.en: My flatmate used tethering to open a course page on her laptop on the bus.
examples.zh: 室友在公交上用「共享手机网络功能」，在笔记本电脑上打开课程网页。

examples.en: The mobile plan listed a separate allowance for tethering while away from campus.
examples.zh: 手机套餐列出了离开学校时用于「共享手机网络功能」的单独额度。

words.enDefinition: a password used to let another device join a wireless hotspot

examples.en: I checked the hotspot password before sharing the connection with my own laptop.
examples.zh: 我连接自己的笔记本电脑共享网络前，先查了「热点连接密码」。

examples.en: The phone showed the hotspot password in the settings under the network name.
examples.zh: 手机设置在网络名称下方显示了「热点连接密码」。

words.enDefinition: equipment that lets nearby wireless devices connect to a network

examples.en: The Wi-Fi access point was mounted high on the wall in our study room.
examples.zh: 「无线网络接入点」装在我们自习室墙上较高的位置。

examples.en: The building manager listed work on a Wi-Fi access point near the north stairs.
examples.zh: 楼管列出了北侧楼梯附近一个「无线网络接入点」的维护工作。

collocations: connect to a Wi-Fi access point

words.enDefinition: the identifier used for a wireless network, which can be displayed to nearby devices

examples.en: The library guide printed its network name beside the opening hours at the entrance.
examples.zh: 图书馆指南在入口开放时间旁印了「网络名称」。

examples.en: I checked the network name before joining the guest connection at the careers fair.
examples.zh: 招聘会上，我先核对了「网络名称」，才连接访客无线网。

words.enDefinition: how strongly a device receives a particular wireless signal

examples.en: I checked the signal strength near my desk before starting the online tutorial.
examples.zh: 开始上网课前，我查看了桌子附近的「信号强度」。

examples.en: The app showed better signal strength at the other end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 应用显示，走廊另一端的「信号强度」更好。

words.enDefinition: the distance within which a wireless network's signal can be used

examples.en: Our table was within Wi-Fi range even at the far end of the study hall.
examples.zh: 即使在自习大厅远端，我们的桌子仍在「无线网络覆盖范围」内。

examples.en: I asked whether the building's Wi-Fi range extended into the courtyard outside the library.
examples.zh: 我问这栋楼的「无线网络覆盖范围」是否延伸到图书馆外的庭院。

words.enDefinition: a range of radio frequencies used by a wireless network

examples.en: My phone displayed a different Wi-Fi band from the one listed on the laptop.
examples.zh: 我手机显示的「无线网频段」和笔记本电脑上列出的不同。

examples.en: The support page explained which Wi-Fi band the older tablet could connect to.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了较旧的平板可以连接哪个「无线网频段」。

words.enDefinition: a Wi-Fi roaming service for students and staff at participating education and research institutions

examples.en: I could use eduroam when I visited another university for a workshop in June.
examples.zh: 六月去另一所大学参加工作坊时，我能用「教育科研无线漫游网」。

examples.en: The orientation guide listed eduroam under wireless networks available near the library and residence.
examples.zh: 迎新指南把「教育科研无线漫游网」列为图书馆和宿舍附近可用的无线网络。

words.enDefinition: a page requiring a sign-in or acceptance of terms before full internet access

examples.en: The station's captive portal appeared when I opened a browser before boarding the train.
examples.zh: 上火车前我打开浏览器，车站的「联网前认证页面」弹了出来。

examples.en: I could see the Wi-Fi icon even though the captive portal had not loaded.
examples.zh: 虽然「联网前认证页面」还没出来，我已经能看到无线网图标。

collocations: sign in through a captive portal

words.enDefinition: to agree to a provider's stated conditions for using its network

examples.en: I had to accept network terms before opening my university timetable at the station.
examples.zh: 我先「同意网络使用条件」，才能在车站打开学校课表。

examples.en: The welcome screen asked visitors to accept network terms for the temporary connection.
examples.zh: 欢迎页面请访客「同意网络使用条件」，以使用临时网络。

collocations: prompt someone to accept network terms

words.enDefinition: to connect a device to an available wired or wireless network

examples.en: I checked the name before trying to join a network in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 在会议室尝试「连接某个网络」前，我核对了名称。

examples.en: My laptop asked if it should join a network without a password automatically.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑问，要不要自动「连接到不设密码的网络」。

words.enDefinition: to connect a device again after a wireless connection ended or failed

examples.en: I had to reconnect to Wi-Fi after moving from the library to the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆走到阶梯教室后，不得不「重新连接无线网」。

examples.en: The tablet tried to reconnect to Wi-Fi when I opened its screen after lunch.
examples.zh: 我午饭后打开屏幕时，平板尝试「重新连接无线网」。

words.zhGloss: 移除此网络的保存信息
words.enDefinition: a setting that removes a previously saved wireless network from a device
acceptedZhAnswers: 移除此网络的保存信息

examples.en: The settings offered forget this network for the hotspot I'd used while travelling.
examples.zh: 设置中，我旅行时用过的热点有「移除此网络的保存信息」这个选项。

examples.en: I tapped forget this network for a connection I no longer used on campus.
examples.zh: 我对一个在校园里已经不用的连接点了「移除此网络的保存信息」。

words.enDefinition: a network whose connection information is stored on a device for later use

examples.en: The phone recognized the saved network when I returned to the same study room.
examples.zh: 我回到同一间自习室时，手机认出了「已保存的网络」。

examples.en: I checked the name of the saved network before deleting it from the list.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「已保存的网络」的名称，再把它从列表移除。

words.enDefinition: a setting letting a device connect automatically to an available saved network

examples.en: I turned off auto-join for the guest network on the train that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，我关掉了火车访客网络的「自动连接已知网络」功能。

examples.en: The phone showed auto-join was available for the campus connection I had saved.
examples.zh: 手机显示我保存的校园连接可以使用「自动连接已知网络」。

words.zhGloss: 无线网已连接但无法上网
words.enDefinition: a status saying a device has joined Wi-Fi but cannot reach the internet
acceptedZhAnswers: 无线网已连接但无法上网

examples.en: The tablet displayed Wi-Fi connected without internet even though the signal was strong.
examples.zh: 虽然信号很强，平板却显示「无线网已连接但无法上网」。

examples.en: Our phone showed Wi-Fi connected without internet while the library's provider investigated a fault.
examples.zh: 图书馆的运营商调查故障期间，我们的手机显示「无线网已连接但无法上网」。

words.enDefinition: a state in which a device connects to a network but has restricted or no access to the internet

examples.en: My laptop reported limited connectivity on the wired network at my study station.
examples.zh: 笔记本接上自习工位的有线网络后，提示「网络连接受限」。

examples.en: The support desk said limited connectivity explained why our shared documents would not open.
examples.zh: 技术服务台说，「网络连接受限」是共享文档打不开的原因。

words.enDefinition: a message saying an attempt to connect took longer than the allowed time

examples.en: The page displayed connection timed out while I was trying to open the course calendar.
examples.zh: 我尝试打开课程日历时，页面显示「连接超时」。

examples.en: I saw connection timed out once before the portal loaded normally on the second attempt.
examples.zh: 门户网站第二次正常加载之前，我看到了一次「连接超时」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a particular network cannot currently be reached or used

examples.en: The printer showed network unavailable just before our group was due to hand in its poster.
examples.zh: 我们小组快交海报时，打印机显示「网络不可用」。

examples.en: The phone displayed network unavailable after moving out of range of the usual campus connection.
examples.zh: 手机离开平时校园网的覆盖范围后，显示「网络不可用」。

words.enDefinition: options for changing how a device connects to communication networks

examples.en: The help desk asked me to check my network settings before our next video tutorial.
examples.zh: 下次视频辅导课前，服务台请我检查「网络设置」。

examples.en: I found the setting for the wired connection under network settings on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本电脑的「网络设置」里找到了有线连接的选项。

words.enDefinition: disruption caused by other signals or sources affecting wireless communication

examples.en: The adviser suggested signal interference when the connection slowed near the crowded study room.
examples.zh: 连接在自习室人多的地方变慢后，技术人员认为可能有「无线信号干扰」。

examples.en: The report mentioned signal interference as a possible factor in one area of the building.
examples.zh: 报告说，这栋楼的某个区域可能有「无线信号干扰」。

words.enDefinition: a socket used to connect a device through an Ethernet cable

examples.en: I found an Ethernet port on the wall behind the desk in my room.
examples.zh: 我在房间书桌后面的墙上找到了一个「以太网接口」。

examples.en: The new laptop did not have an Ethernet port for our wired connection.
examples.zh: 新笔记本电脑没有连接我们有线网络用的「以太网接口」。

words.enDefinition: a component or device allowing a computer to connect to a network

examples.en: My flatmate borrowed a network adapter for the older laptop in the common room.
examples.zh: 室友为公共休息室里的旧笔记本电脑借了一个「网络适配器」。

examples.en: The technician checked which network adapter my computer was using for its wired connection.
examples.zh: 技术人员查看了我的电脑用哪个「网络适配器」进行有线连接。

words.enDefinition: a test measuring how quickly an internet connection transfers data

examples.en: I ran a speed test before asking the residence office about our slow connection.
examples.zh: 询问宿管办公室为什么网络慢之前，我做了一次「网速测试」。

examples.en: The speed test gave different results in the study room and the common area.
examples.zh: 「网速测试」在自习室和公共区域给出了不同的结果。

words.enDefinition: the delay between sending data and its arrival or the return of a response

examples.en: The technician noticed higher latency when our class started a video call that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我们班开始视频通话时，技术人员发现「网络延迟」变高了。

examples.en: I asked whether the reported latency affected our online discussion more than download speed.
examples.zh: 我问，检测到的「网络延迟」是不是比下载速度更影响我们的网络讨论。

words.enDefinition: a situation in which some transmitted data packets fail to reach their destination

examples.en: The report showed packet loss during the part of the call that kept cutting out.
examples.zh: 报告显示，通话反复断线的那一段出现了「数据包丢失」。

examples.en: I asked whether packet loss could explain why some words were missing from the audio.
examples.zh: 我问，音频里有些词听不到是否可能是「数据包丢失」导致的。

words.enDefinition: the rate at which a network connection can send or receive data

examples.en: I compared the connection speed in the library with the speed in my residence.
examples.zh: 我比较了图书馆和宿舍的「网络传输速率」。

examples.en: The upload finished sooner after the connection speed improved that evening on campus.
examples.zh: 那晚校园的「网络传输速率」改善后，上传更快完成了。

words.enDefinition: a period when a network service is unavailable to some or all users

examples.en: The notice reported a network outage in the study building before my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午的课开始前，通知说自习楼里出现了「网络服务中断」。

examples.en: Our class moved offline during the network outage and met in the usual room.
examples.zh: 在「网络服务中断」期间，我们班改成线下，还是在平时的教室见面。

words.enDefinition: a light on a router showing its current condition or activity

examples.en: I could see the router indicator light from my desk on the opposite wall.
examples.zh: 我从对面墙边的桌子能看见「路由器状态灯」。

examples.en: The help page explained what each colour of the router indicator light meant.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了「路由器状态灯」每一种颜色分别表示什么。

collocations: colour of the router indicator light

words.enDefinition: high-speed internet service supplied to a house or other residence

examples.en: Our home broadband was ready the week before I moved into the flat.
examples.zh: 我搬进公寓的前一周，我们的「家庭宽带」就开通了。

examples.en: I compared home broadband with a cellular connection for working from the residence.
examples.zh: 我比较了「家庭宽带」和蜂窝连接在宿舍里工作的表现。

words.enDefinition: the process of keeping the same mobile number when changing service providers

examples.en: I read about mobile number porting before switching to a cheaper monthly plan.
examples.zh: 换成更便宜的月费套餐前，我了解了「手机号码携号转网」。

examples.en: The provider explained how mobile number porting affected the temporary number it had supplied.
examples.zh: 运营商说明了「手机号码携号转网」会怎样影响它提供的临时号码。

words.enDefinition: a request for an existing telephone number to be moved to another provider

examples.en: The provider acknowledged my porting request before giving me an expected transfer date.
examples.zh: 运营商受理了我的「携号转网申请」，随后告知预计转网日期。

examples.en: I checked whether my porting request was still pending in the account that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，我在账户里查看了自己的「携号转网申请」是否还在处理。

words.enDefinition: the day arranged for an existing number to move to a new service provider

examples.en: The message listed my scheduled port date as the first Friday of the summer term.
examples.zh: 消息把我的「计划号码转网日期」定在夏季学期第一个周五。

examples.en: I wrote the scheduled port date in my calendar before starting the new course.
examples.zh: 开始新课程前，我把「计划号码转网日期」记到了日历里。

words.enDefinition: a phone number assigned for use for a limited time

examples.en: The carrier gave me a temporary mobile number before the transfer was completed.
examples.zh: 转网完成前，运营商给了我一个「临时手机号码」。

examples.en: I copied the temporary mobile number from the letter into my university contact form.
examples.zh: 我把信上的「临时手机号码」抄进了学校的联系信息表。

words.enDefinition: a UK code used to keep a mobile number when switching providers

examples.en: The UK information sheet described how the Porting Authorisation Code related to keeping the same number.
examples.zh: 英国的说明单描述了「英国携号转网授权码」和保留原号码之间的关系。

examples.en: The provider's reply included my Porting Authorisation Code and the date it would expire.
examples.zh: 运营商的回复里有「英国携号转网授权码」和它的到期日。

words.zhGloss: 英国换商不保号授权码
words.enDefinition: a UK code for switching mobile providers without keeping the previous number
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国换商不保号授权码

examples.en: The Ofcom page described a Service Termination Authorisation Code for customers choosing a new number.
examples.zh: Ofcom 的网页介绍了选择新号码的客户使用的「英国换商不保号授权码」。

examples.en: The provider explained how the Service Termination Authorisation Code differed from the code for keeping numbers.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了「英国换商不保号授权码」与保留号码所用代码有什么区别。

collocations: request a Service Termination Authorisation Code
receive a Service Termination Authorisation Code

words.enDefinition: a status confirming a number has been moved to its new provider

examples.en: I saw number transfer complete on the account page while riding home from campus.
examples.zh: 从校园坐车回家时，我在账户页面上看到了「号码转网已完成」。

examples.en: The carrier sent a message marked number transfer complete just before my seminar started.
examples.zh: 研讨课开始前不久，运营商发来了一条标有「号码转网已完成」的消息。

words.enDefinition: a status saying the request to move a number is still being processed

examples.en: The app displayed number transfer pending after the new plan appeared on my account.
examples.zh: 新套餐显示在账户上后，应用显示「号码转网待处理」。

examples.en: I asked about number transfer pending after seeing the same status the next day.
examples.zh: 第二天我看到状态还是「号码转网待处理」，就问了一下。

words.enDefinition: a fee that may apply when a contract ends before its agreed term

examples.en: I checked the early termination charge before asking about moving to a different phone provider.
examples.zh: 询问转到另一家手机运营商之前，我查了「提前终止合同费用」。

examples.en: The letter listed the early termination charge separately from my usual monthly service fee.
examples.zh: 信上把「提前终止合同费用」与平时的月服务费分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the initial agreed period you must stay on a service contract to avoid a possible charge for leaving early

examples.en: I compared the minimum contract term with the length of my exchange programme abroad.
examples.zh: 我把「合同最短履行期限」与在国外交换学习的时长做了比较。

examples.en: The provider showed the minimum contract term on the page before I selected a plan.
examples.zh: 我选套餐前，运营商在页面上显示了「合同最短履行期限」。

words.enDefinition: a phone that can be used on compatible networks from more than one provider

examples.en: I took an unlocked handset to the residence so I could choose a provider locally.
examples.zh: 我带了一部「无运营商锁的手机」去宿舍，这样可以在当地选择运营商。

examples.en: The seller confirmed it was an unlocked handset before letting me check the model number.
examples.zh: 卖家先确认这是「无运营商锁的手机」，再让我查型号。

words.enDefinition: a phone sold without an included SIM or mobile service plan

examples.en: The shop showed me a SIM-free handset on a separate display from the contract deals.
examples.zh: 商店把「不随附手机卡的手机」摆在和合约套餐分开的展台上，并拿了一部给我看。

examples.en: I bought a SIM-free handset after finding a cheaper plan from my existing provider.
examples.zh: 原运营商有更便宜的套餐，我就买了部「不随附手机卡的手机」。

words.enDefinition: a plan option that lets customers use a compatible phone they already own

examples.en: I selected bring your own phone because my old handset still worked well on campus.
examples.zh: 旧手机在校园用得还不错，所以我选了「自备手机入网」。

examples.en: The provider asked which model I had after I chose bring your own phone.
examples.zh: 我选择「自备手机入网」后，运营商问我的手机是什么型号。

words.enDefinition: a check of whether a device can work with the provider's service

examples.en: I completed a device compatibility check before ordering a SIM for my old tablet.
examples.zh: 为旧平板订购手机卡之前，我做了「设备兼容性检查」。

examples.en: The device compatibility check asked for the model name rather than the colour.
examples.zh: 「设备兼容性检查」要求提供型号名称，没有问设备颜色。

words.enDefinition: a mobile plan that includes service for several lines on one account

examples.en: My sister and I shared a family phone plan while attending different universities.
examples.zh: 姐姐和我在不同的大学读书期间，共用一个「家庭手机套餐」。

examples.en: I checked whether our family phone plan still covered the old tablet's line.
examples.zh: 我确认了「家庭手机套餐」是不是还包含旧平板那条线路。

words.enDefinition: a plan with one data allowance used by multiple devices or mobile lines

examples.en: The shared data plan showed both phones using the same pool of data.
examples.zh: 「共享流量套餐」显示两部手机用的是同一份流量额度。

examples.en: We chose a shared data plan because our phones used very different amounts.
examples.zh: 两部手机的用量相差很大，所以我们选择了「共享流量套餐」。

collocations: devices on a shared data plan

words.zhGloss: 新增一条移动通信线路
words.enDefinition: to attach another mobile service line to an existing plan or account
acceptedZhAnswers: 新增一条移动通信线路

examples.en: I asked how much it would cost to add a line to my account.
examples.zh: 我问在自己的账户里「新增一条移动通信线路」要花多少钱。

examples.en: The provider offered to add a line for the tablet under our current plan.
examples.zh: 运营商提出，在现有套餐下为平板「新增一条移动通信线路」。

collocations: add a line to your plan
add a line for a device

words.enDefinition: a menu listing the available mobile networks or the way to select them

examples.en: I opened the network selection menu after my bus crossed into the next region.
examples.zh: 公交车驶入下一个地区后，我打开了「移动网络选择菜单」。

examples.en: The network selection menu showed the names of two compatible providers in the area.
examples.zh: 「移动网络选择菜单」显示本地有两家兼容的运营商。

collocations: return to the network selection menu

words.enDefinition: an overview of the service use recorded against an account

examples.en: I checked my account usage summary after using the phone more often that week.
examples.zh: 那一周手机用得更多，我查看了「账户用量汇总」。

examples.en: The account usage summary showed a separate total for each line on our plan.
examples.zh: 「账户用量汇总」分别显示了套餐下各条线路的使用总量。

words.enDefinition: a cable used to connect a computer or other device to a wired network

examples.en: I found an Ethernet cable in the drawer beside my old laptop charger.
examples.zh: 我在装旧笔记本电脑充电器的抽屉里找到了「以太网网线」。

examples.en: The helper handed me an Ethernet cable for the desktop in our shared study room.
examples.zh: 辅导员递给我一根「以太网网线」，供我们合用自习室的台式机使用。

words.zhGloss: 无线网络信号减弱或中断
words.enDefinition: a phrase saying the wireless signal suddenly weakens or disappears
acceptedZhAnswers: 无线网络信号减弱或中断

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the Wi-Fi signal drops most often in the building.
examples.zh: 导师问，这栋楼里哪里最常出现「无线网络信号减弱或中断」。

examples.en: The laptop sometimes freezes when the Wi-Fi signal drops during a video call.
examples.zh: 视频通话中「无线网络信号减弱或中断」时，笔记本电脑的画面有时会卡住。

collocations: Wi-Fi signal drops in the hallway
check when the Wi-Fi signal drops
notice where the Wi-Fi signal drops
